title: Purple Flowers Clipart Bundle
author: The Paper Princess
description:
This fifty piece Clipart Bundle provides you with decorated embellishments for card making, scrapbooking, Journaling and many other different crafts. The flowers are purple and yellow and have designed hearts, frames, keys, wreaths and lots of other matching embellishments.
We have also included 8 unique 12″x12″ Backgrounds to match the clipart.
